metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Mean off-diagonal cosine similarity of sampled nonpadding item embeddings, mapped to [0,1]. Approximately 0.5 represents mean cosine zero. Higher indicates directional alignment, not a direct measure of recommendation diversity, coverage, or user preferences. Nonfinite sampled embeddings are excluded and counted. Zero vectors follow torch normalization conventions; null means fewer than two finite sampled embeddings.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean of (pos_logit - neg_logit) over valid positions; higher means clearer separation.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: 10th percentile of (pos_logit - neg_logit); lower suggests many hard/confusing cases.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction where neg_logit > pos_logit (margin < 0); lower is better.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction where (pos_logit - neg_logit) < eps; higher means weak separation.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Unavailable: item categories are not provided in this task.
metric_definitions.training_pair_diagnostics: At most ten training batches in evaluation mode, using the trained scoring path. Eligible pairs require nonpadding sequence, positive and negative IDs; nonfinite scores are excluded and counted separately. These are sampled training margins, not validation HR@10 or full-catalog ranks. Final-position pairwise ranks compare one positive with one sampled negative at the final nonpadding sequence position: strict positive wins have rank 0, strict losses rank 1, exact ties span ranks 0..1. Residual ratios are ||returned features - captured last_layernorm output|| / ||captured output|| at finite nonpadding positions with nonzero backbone norm. This hook assumes last_layernorm is the final backbone normalization; zero-backbone and nonfinite positions are reported separately. Quantiles summarize observed ratios only; they do not prove an architectural bound or bounded logits. Missing measurements use null values or explicit unavailable states.
metric_definitions.embedding_sample: Sampled nonpadding item count, finite and nonfinite item counts, zero-vector count among finite items, and unordered pair count among finite sampled items. Partial measurements are labeled.
metric_definitions.history_duplicate_prevalence: Public training histories only: repeat_event_count is the sum of history length minus unique-item count, excluding padding; its fraction uses all observed events as denominator. This describes whole histories, not specifically the residual pooling window.
